profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
A technology guy who is always passionate about bringing user-friendly applications to public.

Specialties: C/C++, Java, Javascript, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- FileMaker
• Developed web version of FileMaker compatible with the native application to allow customers accessing and modifying database solutions via browsers.
• Investigated and resolved performance and scalability issues.
• Implemented server side database interactions and scripts.
• Re-built ten year old FileMaker administration console from scratch with modern web technology.
• Delivered restful APIs to manage database privileges and settings without FAC.
• Worked on miscellaneous tasks such as bug fixes, customer issues, Apache/IIS configurations and rewrite rules, OAuth/AppleConnect integrations, web security and cookie management.
• Building UI for our new product...

Skills: Java, Javascript, C++, HTML, CSS, Angular, Node.js, Vaadin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Title: Sims 4
• Implemented sharable UI components that are reusable across the game.
• Built gameplay specific UI prototypes, user interactions, visual effects and animations based on the design.
• Incorporated design/function changes and performance improvement with prototypes throughout UI iterations.
• Polished prototypes to final products.

Skills: Actionscript, C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Title: Project Gibson
• Developed gameplay features on both client and server.
• Prototyped and improved client side UI.
• Implemented Restful APIs and playerdata versioning system.
• Worked closely with service team to improve build process and scripts.
• Fixed bugs and improved code base on both ends.
• Wrote unit tests.

Skills: C#, Java, Unity3D, Couchbase

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Title: Dragon Age Legends
• Implemented & optimized client side user interface on a regular basis.
• Developed gameplay, in-game purchase, and other game features on both client and server.
• Highly involved in every other aspect of the game including PvP and co-op mode, news and updates, as well as in-game message system.
• Helped improve the server stability and game logic validations.
• Integrated external technologies into the game, such as social services from Facebook, account management and payment mechanisms from EA.
• Wrote documents & unit tests for quality assurance.

Skills: Actionscript, Java, MongoDB

Title: Weewar
• Re-wrote the entire game in Actionscript.
• Re-designed/implemented user interface.
• Implemented tutorial, chat room and social network related features.
• Enabled flash client/web frame communications for instant web events such as invitation and gifting. 
• Integrated FB connect.

Skills: Actionscript, Java

projects.title: Dragon Age Legends
projects.description: Free online RPG that brought the magic of BioWare's Dragon Age to Facebook and Google Plus, being a launch title for the latter.

projects.title: Weewar
projects.description: Weewar is an award winning turn based strategy game. Up to 6 players can command their pixel armies against each other on the thousands of maps, generated by the community.
